card.name: Digits in converted imperial measurements
card.fires_on: Digits inside the converted imperial figure in parentheses after a metric measurement, such as (30 ft 3.2 in) or (16 mi). It fires before the imperial unit like ft, in, or mi appears.

modes.label: Digits before ft or in
modes.description: Digit within a feet-and-inches conversion after a metre or millimetre value.

modes.label: Digits before mi
modes.description: Digit within a miles conversion after a kilometre or metre value.

card.writes: It promotes imperial unit tokens like mi, ft, and ki, and suppresses uppercase abbreviations such as KG and KM.
card.plain: It marks a number in brackets that is the imperial conversion of a metric measurement, just before units like feet or miles.
